paragraphs: Rav Menasya, grandson of R. Menasya, in Rav Menasya the elder's name, Yoma 4b: Menasya, grandson of R. Masya, in R. Musya's name. R. Levi in R. Menasya's name, Yelammedenu, Aḥarei Mot. [The differing patronymic and attribution formulations are retained.]
